Description: private key and cert for radas signing
How to rotate:
See Pyxis access request and https://issues.redhat.com/browse/RHTAPREL-627
- Use service-account-credentials found as key in Vault.
- Once new certificate created and it should be added to Vault as new version
- It should then be propagated to RemoteSecrets (See Adding a Secret to a Managed Workspace on how to update)
- The old certificate needs to be revoked.
- Determine the serial number:
openssl x509 -in hacbs-release-pyxis.crt -noout -text | grep 'Serial Number'
- Note the item in brackets (0xffe15d7)

- Go to https://redhat.service-now.com/ and click Support Services at the top right corner, or go directly to https://redhat.service-now.com/help?id=rh_service_catalog
- Then click Request General Support at the bottom left. 
- Select IT.
Is there a service degradation? No
Select the app: RHCS
Are you requesting something new? New

- Enter the following as the body:

Please revoke the following certificates.
- 0xffe15d7 (<- change this)
